description:
Ever since he became Tae-geon’s boyfriend, Yoo-an has been plagued by anxiety every day. Eventually, he manages to confine Tae-geon… But then, Tae-geon—who had always been so mature and gentle—began to reveal his true colors.

*“Tae… Tae-geon, you can’t leave this house from now on.”  
“So… I’m supposed to live here now?”  
“I-I’ll take care of you for the rest of your life… I’ll provide for you. And I’ll do… anything you want.”*

Taegon replied with a gentle smile, showing little sign of being the one who had just been locked up.

*“Then… if I show you the side of me I’ve been hiding for fear you might dislike it, would that put your mind at ease?”*

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
